ValidationRule.description: Whenever HR Approves then CPR Number & CPR Expiry are Mandatory fields and it is applicable to Credit Card, Credit Limit Increase & Cash Collateral Application
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( TEXT(Region_Flag__c) == 'Bahrain', ISCHANGED(cc_HR_Result__c), ISPICKVAL(cc_HR_Result__c, "Approved"), ($User.LastName <> "Integration"), OR( ISNULL(cc_CPR_Expiry_Date__c), ISBLANK(cc_CPR_Number__c) ), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Application"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, "New Credit Card") ), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Limit Increase Application"), ISPICKVAL(Type , "Credit Card Cash Collateral Application") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in the CPR Number and CPR Expiry Date fields.
